parsed.summary: A desktop dispatch workspace that keeps the repair queue, visit constraints, technician fit, and handoff decision visible without exposing implementation machinery.
parsed.css: :root{color-scheme:light;--ink:#17211d;--muted:#64706a;--line:#d9e0dc;--soft:#f3f6f4;--paper:#fff;--green:#176b4a;--green-soft:#e7f4ed;--amber:#8a5708;--amber-soft:#fff3d6;--red:#a63d32;--red-soft:#fae9e6;--navy:#20364f}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#edf1ee;color:var(--ink);font:14px/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.dispatch-app{width:100%;min-height:900px;background:var(--soft)}button{font:inherit}.topbar{height:68px;padding:0 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.brand-mark{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;background:#56b789;color:#102b20;font-weight:800}.brand strong{display:block;font-size:16px}.brand span{display:block;color:#c9d7e2;font-size:12px}.top-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;color:#dbe5ec}.top-meta strong{color:#fff}.workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:290px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:832px}.queue-panel{padding:22px 18px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);background:#f8faf9}.panel-heading,.section-heading{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.panel-heading h1{margin:0;font-size:18px}.panel-heading p,.section-heading p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.count{padding:3px 8px;border-radius:99px;background:#e4eae6;color:#43504a;font-size:12px}.filter-row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:18px 0 14px}.filter{padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:#fff;color:#58635e}.filter.active{border-color:#789e8d;background:#e8f2ed;color:#185d42;font-weight:700}.queue-list{display:grid;gap:9px}.queue-item{width:100%;padding:14px;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:inherit}.queue-item.selected{border-color:#2c7a59;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 #2c7a59;background:#f4faf7}.queue-top,.queue-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.queue-top strong{font-size:13px}.queue-item h2{margin:7px 0 9px;font-size:15px}.queue-bottom{align-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.state{font-weight:700}.state.blocked{color:var(--amber)}.state.risk{color:var(--red)}.detail{padding:24px 28px 32px;overflow:hidden}.visit-header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;margin-bottom:18px}.eyebrow{margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--green);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}.visit-header h1{margin:0;font-size:26px;line-height:1.2}.visit-header p{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}.sla-card{min-width:190px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #e5bd75;border-radius:10px;background:var(--amber-soft)}.sla-card span{display:block;color:#76511d;font-size:12px}.sla-card strong{display:block;margin-top:2px;color:#70450a;font-size:18px}.content-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(320px,.8fr);gap:18px}.card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(22,34,28,.04)}.card-body{padding:18px}.section-heading{margin-bottom:15px}.section-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:16px}.badge{padding:4px 9px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.badge.amber{background:var(--amber-soft);color:var(--amber)}.badge.green{background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green)}.fact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}.fact{min-height:88px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:#fafcfb}.fact span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.fact strong{display:block;margin:6px 0 2px}.fact small{color:var(--muted)}.fact.attention{border-color:#e4b963;background:#fffaf0}.constraint-list{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}.constraint{display:flex;gap:11px;padding:12px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--soft)}.constraint-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;background:#dce7e1;color:var(--green);font-weight:800}.constraint.warning .constraint-icon{background:#f8dfaa;color:var(--amber)}.constraint strong,.constraint span{display:block}.constraint span{margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.tech-card{margin-top:18px}.tech-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:13px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.tech-row:first-of-type{border-top:0}.avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#dbe8e2;color:#245b45;font-weight:800}.tech-copy strong,.tech-copy span{display:block}.tech-copy span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.tech-fit{text-align:right}.tech-fit strong,.tech-fit span{display:block}.tech-fit strong{color:var(--green)}.tech-fit span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.decision-card{position:sticky;top:20px}.decision-options{display:grid;gap:9px}.decision-option{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:#fff}.decision-option.selected{border-color:#348061;background:#f1f8f4}.radio{flex:0 0 16px;width:16px;height:16px;margin-top:2px;border:2px solid #98a49e;border-radius:50%}.selected .radio{border:5px solid var(--green)}.decision-option strong,.decision-option span{display:block}.decision-option span{margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.handoff{margin-top:16px;padding:14px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--soft)}.handoff h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:13px}.handoff dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:88px 1fr;gap:8px;margin:0}.handoff dt{color:var(--muted)}.handoff dd{margin:0;font-weight:650}.notice{margin-top:14px;padding:11px 12px;border-left:3px solid var(--amber);background:var(--amber-soft);color:#694717;font-size:12px}.actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}.btn{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#33413a;font-weight:700}.btn.primary{grid-column:1/-1;border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green);color:#fff}.footer-note{margin:10px 0 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}@media(max-width:1000px){.workspace{grid-template-columns:250px 1fr}.content-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.decision-card{position:static}.fact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
